pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition on sequential order stacking within 5 minutes or 1.0 ATR of an existing losing position; zero scaling into falling/rising momentum wicks.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero entry authorized unless the 14-period ATR is below the 50-period moving average and order-specific hard stop-loss is mathematically hardcoded to cap maximum capital drawdown strictly at $5.00.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing volatility stops or partial harvests immediately upon reaching +$15.00 floating profit to lock down asymmetric win capture up to +$30.00.
